text: The Sun just vanished. But you won't know... for eight minutes.
Its last light is still racing toward us.
So the sky stays blue, and Earth keeps orbiting... nothing.
Then the timer hits zero. Lights out.
A second later, the Moon goes dark too.
Every plant stops growing. Only city lights still shine.
Earth drifts off into space, at thirty kilometers every second.
In one week, it's minus eighteen. Your breath turns to fog.
In one year, minus seventy three. The oceans freeze, and Earth turns white.
But deep under the ice, hot vents keep some life alive.
And the Sun you see right now? That light is already eight minutes old.
So how would you know... if it just vanished?
